w:CT_PageSz/@w.note: Document page.width: normalized geometry and single-section DOCX output; omitted orientation uses portrait dimensions.

w:CT_PageSz/@h.note: Document page.height: normalized geometry and single-section DOCX output; omitted orientation uses portrait dimensions.

w:CT_PageSz/@orient.note: Document page.orientation: normalized geometry and single-section DOCX output; omitted orientation uses portrait dimensions.

w:CT_PageMar/@top.note: Document margin.top: non-negative lengths and single-section DOCX output. Negative signed margins are unsupported.

w:CT_PageMar/@right.note: Document margin.right: non-negative lengths and single-section DOCX output.

w:CT_PageMar/@bottom.note: Document margin.bottom: non-negative lengths and single-section DOCX output. Negative signed margins are unsupported.

w:CT_PageMar/@left.note: Document margin.left: non-negative lengths and single-section DOCX output.

w:CT_PageMar/@header.note: Document margin.header: non-negative lengths and single-section DOCX output.

w:CT_PageMar/@footer.note: Document margin.footer: non-negative lengths and single-section DOCX output.

w:CT_PageMar/@gutter.note: Document margin.gutter: non-negative lengths and single-section DOCX output.

w:CT_SectPr/pgSz.note: Named paper sizes, explicit dimensions and orientation are supported; printer paper codes are unsupported. Implicit and explicit sections are supported.

w:CT_SectPr/pgMar.note: All seven margin fields are supported for non-negative lengths; negative top/bottom margins are unsupported. Implicit and explicit sections are supported.

w:CT_Columns/@num.note: Document columns.count: validated model and equal-width DOCX columns when count is present.

w:CT_Columns/@space.note: Document columns.gap: validated model and equal-width DOCX columns when count is present.

w:CT_Columns/@sep.note: Document columns.separator: validated model and equal-width DOCX columns when count is present.

w:CT_Columns/@equalWidth.note: columns.equal_width retains explicit booleans; DOCX supports equal-width columns and rejects false. Individual widths remain unsupported.

w:CT_SectPr/cols.note: Implicit and explicit sections: equal-width columns with count, gap and separator. Individual column widths remain unsupported.

w:CT_Styles/docDefaults.note: Document font, size and language defaults are emitted; arbitrary default run/paragraph properties are unsupported.

w:CT_DocDefaults/rPrDefault.note: Document font, size and language defaults are emitted; other run defaults are unsupported.

w:CT_RPrDefault/rPr.note: Document font, size and language defaults only.

w:CT_RPr/lang.note: Document-level language default only; direct and style-level language properties remain unsupported.

w:CT_Language/@val.note: Document language defaults emit the authored string as the Latin language tag. Script-specific language attributes remain unsupported.

w:CT_Hyperlink/@r:id.note: External `link.url` is emitted through a package relationship; relationship identifiers are generated, not authored.

a:CT_Transform2D/@rot.note: Image `rotation` is normalized, emitted in DrawingML and painted in native output.

a:CT_Transform2D/@flipH.note: Image `flip_horizontal` is normalized, emitted in DrawingML and painted in native output.

a:CT_Transform2D/@flipV.note: Image `flip_vertical` is normalized, emitted in DrawingML and painted in native output.

a:CT_RelativeRect/@l.note: Image `crop.left` maps percentage values; native crop clamps to 0..100 and fills the authored frame. Other rectangle uses are not exposed.

a:CT_RelativeRect/@t.note: Image `crop.top` maps percentage values; native crop clamps to 0..100 and fills the authored frame. Other rectangle uses are not exposed.

a:CT_RelativeRect/@r.note: Image `crop.right` maps percentage values; native crop clamps to 0..100 and fills the authored frame. Other rectangle uses are not exposed.

a:CT_RelativeRect/@b.note: Image `crop.bottom` maps percentage values; native crop clamps to 0..100 and fills the authored frame. Other rectangle uses are not exposed.

a:CT_LuminanceEffect/@bright.note: Image effects map brightness to thousandths of a percent in DrawingML and native painting.

a:CT_LuminanceEffect/@contrast.note: Image effects map contrast to thousandths of a percent in DrawingML and native painting.

a:CT_AlphaModulateFixedEffect/@amt.note: Image effects.transparency maps inverse opacity; native transparency clamps to 0..100. Other alpha-modulation use cases are not exposed.

a:CT_NonVisualDrawingProps/@name.note: Image name uses explicit name, title, then generated media filename in DOCX.

a:CT_NonVisualDrawingProps/@descr.note: Image description uses description, alt, title, then src in DOCX.

a:CT_NonVisualDrawingProps/hlinkClick.note: Image link emits an external hyperlink in DOCX and PDF; additional click-action controls are not exposed.

a:CT_Blip/@r:embed.note: Image src resolves through the asset resolver and embeds original PNG, JPEG or GIF media in DOCX; generated relationship identifiers are not authorable.

a:CT_Blip/grayscl.note: Image effects.grayscale emits the DrawingML effect and paints grayscale in native output.

a:CT_PresetLineDashProperties/@val.note: Image border.style supports solid, dashed and dotted DOCX strokes; native borders remain solid. Other dash values are not exposed.

a:CT_LineProperties/@w.note: Image border.width emits physical DrawingML width and native border geometry. Other line-width users are not exposed.

w:CT_TblPr/tblStyle.note: Named table styles and conditional regions are emitted in editable DOCX.

w:CT_TblPrBase/tblStyle.note: Named table styles and conditional regions are emitted in editable DOCX.

w:CT_TblPr/tblLayout.note: Table layout accepts auto/autofit/fixed; fixed emits a fixed DOCX grid.

w:CT_TblPr/tblW.note: Physical table width is emitted; percentage width is not exposed.

w:CT_TblPr/jc.note: Four Mote alignment values map to left/center/right placement; justify maps to left.

w:CT_TblPr/tblInd.note: Physical indentation is emitted; other width types are not exposed.

w:CT_TblPr/tblCellSpacing.note: Physical cell spacing is emitted; other width types are not exposed.

w:CT_TblPr/tblBorders.note: Physical outside/inside edges, widths and colors are emitted; themed border controls are not exposed.

w:CT_TblPrBase/tblBorders.note: Physical outside/inside edges, widths and colors are emitted; themed border controls are not exposed.

w:CT_TblPr/tblCellMar.note: Physical cell margins and shorthands are emitted; logical edges are not exposed.

w:CT_TblPr/tblLook.note: Declared conditional regions select table look flags; independent look-bit authorship is not exposed.

w:CT_TrPr/tblHeader.note: Row repeat_header emits the repeating-header flag.

w:CT_TrPrBase/tblHeader.note: Row repeat_header emits the repeating-header flag.

w:CT_TrPr/cantSplit.note: Row cant_split emits the row-splitting flag.

w:CT_TrPrBase/cantSplit.note: Row cant_split emits the row-splitting flag.

w:CT_TrPr/trHeight.note: Row height and auto/at_least/exact rules are emitted.

w:CT_TrPrBase/trHeight.note: Row height and auto/at_least/exact rules are emitted.

w:CT_TcPr/gridSpan.note: Positive colspan creates a logical span and editable DOCX gridSpan.

w:CT_TcPrInner/gridSpan.note: Positive colspan creates a logical span and editable DOCX gridSpan.

w:CT_TcPr/vMerge.note: Positive rowspan creates a logical vertical span with restart/continuation DOCX cells.

w:CT_TcPrInner/vMerge.note: Positive rowspan creates a logical vertical span with restart/continuation DOCX cells.

w:CT_TcPrInner/noWrap.note: Cell no_wrap emits an editable DOCX flag.

w:CT_TcPrInner/vAlign.note: Cell top/center/bottom alignment is normalized and emitted.

w:CT_TcPr/tcW.note: Physical cell width is emitted; percentage widths are not exposed.

w:CT_TcPrInner/tcW.note: Physical cell width is emitted; percentage widths are not exposed.

w:CT_TcPr/tcBorders.note: Physical edge styles, widths and colors are emitted; themed controls and diagonal edges are not exposed.

w:CT_TcPrInner/tcBorders.note: Physical edge styles, widths and colors are emitted; themed controls and diagonal edges are not exposed.

w:CT_TcPrInner/shd.note: Cell fill emits a solid hex background; patterns and themes are not exposed.

w:CT_TcPrInner/tcMar.note: Physical cell margins and shorthands are emitted; logical edges are not exposed.

w:CT_TcPrInner/textDirection.note: Cell ltr, rtl, tb_rl and bt_lr are accepted; editable vertical directions and paragraph bidi are emitted. Other standard directions are not exposed.

w:CT_SectPr/headerReference.note: Default story declaration, inheritance and explicit empty resets; separate first/even variants have no authoring mapping.

w:CT_SectPr/footerReference.note: Default story declaration, inheritance and explicit empty resets; separate first/even variants have no authoring mapping.

w:CT_HdrFtrRef/@type.note: Default story only. First and even types have no Mote authoring mapping.

w:CT_SectPr/type.note: properties.start supports every section-start value; native parity and next-column behavior remain limited.

w:CT_SectType/@val.note: properties.start: continuous, next_page, next_column, even_page, odd_page.

w:CT_SectPr/vAlign.note: properties.vertical_alignment: top, center, bottom, justified; both normalizes to justified. Native vertical placement remains top-aligned with a warning.

w:CT_SectPr/pgNumType.note: page_numbering restart/start/format; chapter numbering properties are not mapped.

w:CT_PageNumber/@start.note: page_numbering.start accepts a positive integer; restart without a start selects 1.

w:CT_PageNumber/@fmt.note: page_numbering.format retains a format string. DOCX maps decimal, alphabetic and Roman forms; native page fields are decimal.
